projection.purpose: Unify operations while preserving provider authority.

contract.input: A project model, provider references, permissions and explicit requests.
contract.authority: Original providers own original objects; metadata owns relationships and views.
contract.step: Read through adapters and expose precise status, provenance and allowed actions.
Commit mutations through one authorized, revision-checked boundary.
contract.invariant: A convenient interface never bypasses provider permission or duplicates domain authority.

test.then: Show an honest unavailable state; do not fabricate current content.
